name: Toa Azusa
source:
"[i]Wow, what an incredible coincidence. I never expected to get to meet you at the very end, Taiga. I am so very surprised.[/i]"

Tomohito's older sister and a [b]former magical girl[/b].

She is the complete opposite of her younger brother Tomohito,
she’s introverted and always fidgety and timid.

She attends a different school far away from Taiga and the others,
so they don't run into each other very often.
However, she occasionally takes the bus back to check on how her brother is doing.

[b]Profile[/b]
[i]Height[/i]: 152cm
[i]Measurements[/i]: B87 / W52 / H84
[i]Favorite food[/i]: Egg dishes. Especially the tamagoyaki made by her brother. She prefers the savory kind, not the sweet kind.
[i]Blood type[/i]: B
[i]Birthday[/i]: September 11th

[From official [url=https://kagamied.com/sakumoyu-en/]english website[/url]]

[spoiler]She is the mother of the real Kanade Taiga (not the nameless protagonist)[/spoiler]
